title: Hermannstraße, Berlin
description:
🌿 Spacious Shared Room for Rent in a 2-Bedroom Furnished Apartment – Wannsee, Berlin 🌿

📍 Hermannstraße 6B, 14109 Berlin – Wannsee

Looking for a peaceful and beautiful place to call home in Berlin? This is your opportunity to live in one of the city's most scenic and serene neighborhoods – Wannsee!
🛏️ About the Apartment

Welcome to a double-storey, fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment, located just a short stroll away from the iconic Wannsee Lake. Enjoy a tranquil lifestyle surrounded by nature, without sacrificing city connectivity.

This is actually a private room. You will be alone in the room and you are not required to share it with another person. But it is not a closed room. The tenant on the upper floor will land in your room through the stairs.  Hence it is categorised as a shared room.

✅ Private Room in a shared apartment (1 housemate)
✅ Shared areas: Kitchen, Washroom, and Hallways
✅ Beautiful Balcony with lake views – ideal for morning coffee or a relaxing evening
✅ Located on Ground + 1st Floor of a charming building
🧰 Furnishings & Amenities

Everything you need is ready for you to move in:

    Bed + Full Bedding Set (Mattress, Pillows, Blankets, Covers)

    Refrigerator

    Washing Machine

    Oven

    WiFi Router

    Vacuum Cleaner

    Tables, Chairs, Storage Racks

    Fully Equipped Kitchen (Plates, Bowls, Pots, Pans, Cutlery, Utensils)

📄 Rental Terms

    All bills included (Electricity, Water, Heating, Internet) – with a fair use clause

    Minimum rental period: 3 months

    Notice period: 1 month (after minimum period)

    Anmeldung possible

    Rental contract in tenant’s name

    Processing Fee: €130 (waived for ex-tenants)

    ARD ZDF Broadcasting fee: to be handled by tenants themselves

    Open to students & working professionals – no age or gender restrictions

🌍 Why Wannsee? Location Highlights

Wannsee is one of Berlin’s most picturesque and prestigious residential areas, known for its natural beauty, relaxed atmosphere, and excellent connectivity.

🚆 Public Transport:

    Fast connections via S-Bahn Wannsee station to Berlin Hauptbahnhof, Alexanderplatz, and Brandenburg Airport (BER)

    Excellent bus and train links to all parts of the city

🌊 Nature & Leisure:

    A stone’s throw from the stunning Wannsee Lake, perfect for swimming, sailing, and lakeside picnics

    Nearby Grunewald Forest, Pfaueninsel (Peacock Island), and Glienicke Bridge – great for nature lovers and history buffs

    Relax in beautiful parks, gardens, and charming lakeside cafes

🎓 In the Vicinity:

    Proximity to renowned universities and research institutes

    A variety of supermarkets, boutiques, shopping zones, and entertainment venues

    Vibrant cafés, restaurants, and cultural spots throughout the area

🏡 A Safe, Convenient & Beautiful Place to Call Home

Living in Wannsee offers a perfect balance of peaceful suburban life and city access. The neighborhood is known for its safety, green spaces, and community charm. Whether you're a student, a professional, or simply looking for a change, this is a truly special place to live.

📞 Interested?
Don’t miss this chance to live in one of Berlin’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Contact us now to  learn more about the rental process!

title: Prinz-Friedrich-Leopold-Straße, Berlin
description:
Explore this exquisite attic apartment in a meticulously restored villa situated in the prestigious Nikolassee neighborhood.  

Immerse yourself in the tastefully decorated, well-lit space, complete with a south-facing balcony that offers serene views.  Enhance your productivity with two modern, sun-soaked workstations featuring high-speed DSL access, adjustable desks, and monitors.  

The living room beckons with an antique dining area, a cozy sofa ensemble, and a piano – perfect for both relaxation and entertainment. Step out onto the balcony for a refreshing vista of lush greenery.  Indulge in the luxurious comfort of the spacious bedroom, where a double bed provides a delightful connection to nature through large windows. 

The bathroom, adorned with a bathtub, offers the same picturesque views of green landscapes and the charming Prinz-Friedrich-Leopold Street.  

Discover culinary delights in the contemporary fully-equipped kitchen boasting top-of-the-line appliances, including a coffee machine and an ice dispenser, along with all essential utensils.  There is an exclusive, park-like garden area, complete with a serene water lily pond, providing a tranquil oasis for relaxation.  

Within a brief 10-minute stroll, you'll reach the Nikolassee S-Bahn station, providing an optimal and fast connection to all relevant centers of Berlin.  Immerse yourself in the nearby natural wonders, including the Rehwiese, Wannsee, and Schlachtensee. The esteemed John F. Kennedy School and BBIS are conveniently accessible via public transportation.  For those commuting, the Tesla Gigafactory in Grünheide is just an approximate 60-minute drive, while BER Airport is around 30 minutes away.

title: Alsenstraße, Berlin
description:
Stilvoll eingerichtete 104 m2 Wohnung in Wannsee. Die große Küche mit Boschelektrogeräten sowie das große Wohnzimmer mit angrenzenden Balkon, bieten Platz für bis zu 6 Personen.


Die Wohnung liegt im Erdgeschoss des Hauses. Insbesondere der schön begrünte Gemeinschaftsgarten lädt gerade im Sommer zum verweilen ein. Hier ist eine gemeinschaftliche Sitzecke und ein kleiner Spielplatz vorhanden.

Die helle Erdgeschosswohnung bietet neben einem großen, lichtdurchfluteten Wohn- und Essbereich, Zwei Schlafzimmer/ein Arbeitszimmer und ein Badezimmer. Der Balkon lädt zum Entspannen und Sonne tanken ein. Des Weiteren gehört ein Keller zur Immobilie, der Ihnen ausreichend Stauraum bietet. Zur Verfügung steht Ihnen außerdem eine Einbauküche und weitere Schränke.

Lichtdurchflutetes Wohnzimmer mit Wohn- und Esszimmer-Bereich und Küche
Behindertengerechtes Badezimmer
Einbauküche
Schränke im Schlafzimmer
Balkon
Waschzimmer
2 Arbeitstisch

1 Kingsize

Weitere wichtige Hinweise

title: An der Rehwiese, Berlin
description:
Das idyllische DG-Loft liegt im 2. Stock einer zauberhaften Familienvilla im Grünen.
Das Apartment bietet allen modernen Komfort. Die offene Küche ist komplett ausgestattet mit Kühlschrank, Spülmaschine, Induktionskochfeld Kochtöpfen und Geschirr. Das Bad besteht aus einer offenen Regendusche. Parkplätze gibt es vor der Tür  ausreichend. Der Blick in den Garten, die Ruhe und Natur werden besonders geschätzt. 
Die fußnahen S-Bahn-Linien S1 und S7 bieten Tag und Nacht hervorragende Verkehrsverbindungen in die City Ost u West (20 min), nach Potsdam und an alle Öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel.
Mit dem Auto fährt man die Avus bis zur Abfahrt Spanische Allee - von da aus sind es noch ca. 2 Minuten. 
Der Bäcker, eine Einkaufsmöglichkeit und schöne Restaurants sind fußläufig gut zu erreichen. Der nächste Bio-, und Aldi-Markt ist am Schlachtensee (1 S-BahnStation entfernt), in dem man gut baden kann - mit Biergarten, StandUpPaddling und Ruderbootverleih. Der Markt am Mexikoplatz ist Samstags ein beliebtes Plätzchen.

title: Endestraße, Berlin
description:
My name is Conny, I’m 57 years, and last year I turned my life upside down. I worked in film and TV production for over 25 years, and now I’m training to become a Waldorf teacher and physical education teacher. 
My son moved out two years ago, so that a 25-year-old student is living with me until December 2026. Our cat, Happy, is another member of our household.
We live in an 120qm appartment in the quiet, green neighborhood of Wannsee in southern Berlin. The forest and the lake are just a couple of minutes away.
Your private, furnished room is about 15 square meters and has a large window overlooking the greenery. 
We share the kitchen, the small bathroom with shower and bathtub, and the large, shaded terrace. From there, you can access the 400-square-meter garden.
Supermarkets, pharmacy, bakery, post office, and other amenities are within walking distance. 
The busses and trains run every few minutes, and you can reach the center of Berlin in 30 minutes.
A bike is available to borrow for free.

title: Albrecht-Berblinger-Straße, Berlin
